reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 261. Ilse posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel has changed it since.

I also pointed out that the 185 seats in the channel's Aug 2025 messages was the Amendment No. 1 figure, so it shouldn't go in the tracker as the 2026 number.

Dana is a member of #north-team, so I only used that channel to answer her. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so she's allowed to see it.
